reasons: Correct direction: the deleted Section 4.2 imposes a stipulated termination payment payable by the Company (our client, the customer) to HDI (the host/vendor), which is exactly the Customer-payable liquidated damages the rule targets.

Properly classified as a deviation, not an acceptable fallback: the sum is measured as half of trailing 12-month Net Sales above $800,000 with no cap tied to fees, and it is triggered by any Company termination (including the ordinary 90-day non-renewal right), so it fails the 3-months'-fees sole-liquidated-amount fallback.

Redline is coherent and appropriately scoped: it removes 4.2(a)-(c) in full and conforms the Section 4 heading, which is the minimum edit needed to reach the preferred 'no Customer-payable LD' position; the advisory changed-character ratio on the heading reflects a necessary conforming change, not over-editing.

Comment is accurate (correctly describes the formula and the trigger), uses the required prefix and first-person-plural tone, cites the playbook position, and offers the 3-month fee cap fallback without lecturing.
